title: 叫
teacherNotes: Teacher-approved final source for L177 叫. Latest origin/main at production start is complete through L174 跑; L177 depends on not-yet-merged L175 馬 and L176 停 before production JSON may merge. Provisional learned chars from the handoff are 馬 and 停. Do not merge production JSON, planner-data, or ledger until L175 and L176 are present in latest origin/main. Use Taiwan Traditional Chinese and Taiwan zhuyin only. Images must be square 1:1 compositions using L058 style anchors, with no text, numbers, signs, letters, zhuyin, labels, logos, or watermarks. Audio must be standalone OpenAI charAudio, whole-sentence AI audio, independent G02 prefix/suffix from exact fragments, and independent G05 wrong-choice whole-sentence audio.
